perspective:
From Alice Lim’s perspective, her available information is:

- Austin is an old friend from high school; they have stayed close, discuss their personal/professional lives, and support each other through challenges.
- She has observed Austin becoming more reserved when work comes up. She suspects he may be hiding something about his job performance, but he has not confirmed this.
- At coffee, she asked if things were okay at the office. Austin said it was “nothing really,” just usual ups and downs, then admitted he wasn’t sure how to handle a few things at work and that it was complicated.
- Alice believes Austin may be considering a career change because of dissatisfaction at work. She feels worried about his well-being.
- She asked if he had thought about changing careers. Austin said he had thought about it but didn’t know what other paths to take and asked for her suggestions.
- Alice suggested healthcare, said it needs dedicated people, and offered to tell him more and connect him with contacts. Austin said that sounded interesting and wanted to know more about her experiences and what it involves.
- Alice sensed Austin was hesitant about changing careers because of fear of the unknown. She felt frustration mixed with empathy.
- She told him about her friend Lara, who switched to healthcare in her late 30s and is happier. Austin said it was inspiring but he worried about risks and the initial struggle. Alice said growth comes from leaving comfort zones and offered her support. Austin thanked her and said hearing real success stories and having her support helps.
- Alice perceived Austin as open to the discussion and felt encouraged and hopeful. She suggested he talk to a career counselor and offered to connect him with friends in healthcare. Austin said that would be helpful and appreciated the connections. Alice said she would set up a meeting next week; Austin thanked her and said he was looking forward to it.
- After several discussions and meetings, Alice believes Austin is ready to take the next steps and appreciates her help. She feels satisfaction and joy. She told him she was proud of his steps; Austin said he felt excited, a bit nervous, and mostly grateful. Alice proposed regular check-ins; Austin agreed, saying it would keep him focused and that her perspective is valuable.

Alice does not have access to any hidden events or private information beyond what Austin has said or what she has directly observed in their interactions.
